scope: COV-018x: connective endings before additive particles, three finite adverb bases before 조차, and source-attested additive particle order.

sources.author: 위유 (Wei Wei)
sources.title: 한국어 학습자를 위한 보조사 교육 방안 — 도, 까지, 조차, 마저를 중심으로
sources.access: Complete public PDF obtained through an ordinary browser session after direct web/curl requests failed. Relevant distribution section read in full.
sources.license: CC BY-NC-ND 2.0 KR notice in the original PDF. The PDF and its full example sentences are not redistributed in this repository.
sources.interpretation: Concrete positive examples support 조차 after 어서/으려고/다가, three lexical adverbs, 까지+additive, and additive+subject/object case; 마저 permits 어서. Existing nominalized/indirect-question paths remain. Contextual restrictions do not justify universal lexical pruning.
All notes and examples read from the pinned September 2026 export. The entry documents nominal attachment; the thesis and KAIST supply separately attributed nonnominal evidence.

supported.composition: Existing explicit copulas, auxiliary groups, 답다 derivation, nominalizations, indirect questions, plural suffixes and outer particles preserve their roles. 게 before 조차 is supported by KAIST, not a blanket inference from the thesis.

lexical_fixture.preservation: All word-entry senses, notes, examples and forms retained; English equivalents only, RelatedForm omitted, same-number idioms excluded. 나라 is retained for the unresolved outside/exclusive observation.
lexical_fixture.filter_behavior: 승규 occurs as a proper name in a primary example but has no dictionary entry. The raw required path remains; both dictionary filters remove it, explicitly tested as a dictionary omission.

annotated_fixture.interpretation: Ten complete source sentences, all ten additive target groups recovered. Four previously missing target cases are gained. One unrelated 있을라치면 miss remains; no gold rows rewritten. These are exposed regression fixtures, not unseen evaluation.

observations.reason: The author labels 밖에 a focus particle, but the sentence describes going outside one’s country and may involve noun 밖 plus 에. Do not license particle 밖에+조차 solely from this ambiguous segmentation.

The 마저 section refers to 조차 in its example-33 explanation. Its time-adverb generalization contradicts the next paragraph; 오늘 in the example can be nominal. The case-order prose also conflicts with the displayed order. Implement concrete positive forms rather than broad categories or universal semantic bans.
KAIST MH2_0045-s154/14 supports 게+조차 despite the thesis’s broad adverbial-ending restriction. Do not transfer that generalization to a categorical ban.
The thesis example does not isolate an adverbial role from nominal 오늘. Existing nominal path remains; no adverbial 마저 expansion from this example.
Preserved full sentence contains a preexisting unrelated predicate-ending miss. Needs its own source review.
NIKL spelling Article 41 explicitly illustrates this chain; current output lacks 학교+에서+처럼. Track separately from additive particle scope.
